item.title: ai: Microsoft Foundry extension for Azure Developer CLI is generally available
item.description:
The Microsoft Foundry extension for Azure Developer CLI is now generally available. It lets you set up, test, evaluate, and deploy hosted agents while keeping agent and deployment configuration with your code.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Developer CLI (azd) Extension Framework
item.description:
The Azure Developer CLI (azd) Extension Framework is now generally available. It lets developers, teams, and partners extend azd with custom capabilities for their application development workflows.

  • Source: Azure Updates
